projects.title: SkyOdeals — Flight Booking & Travel Portal
projects.architecture: Custom PHP, MySQL, Bootstrap & REST APIs
projects.description: A high-performance travel and flight booking portal engineered with custom PHP backend, real-time fare search filtering, promotional deal carousels, and responsive enquiry workflows.
projects.overview: SkyOdeals is a premier international flight and hotel booking agency platform. We developed a comprehensive web portal that allows prospective travelers to search routes, explore discounted international airfares, compare airline deals, and submit customized booking quote requests directly to travel agents.
projects.challenge: The agency required a responsive, lightning-fast web platform capable of handling complex multi-city flight search UI, dynamic promotional fare banners, and customer booking lead capture that converts visitors into confirmed reservations across low-bandwidth mobile connections.
projects.approach: Architected a modular PHP application with efficient database indexing for flight packages, dynamic search widgets using vanilla JavaScript and Bootstrap, and streamlined customer lead routing to travel agents for immediate follow-up via call or WhatsApp.
whatWasBuilt: Dynamic multi-city and round-trip flight search and inquiry interface
Custom PHP & MySQL backend with deal management and automated booking quote generation
Mobile-first responsive frontend built with Bootstrap and modern CSS3 transitions
Promotional deal carousels, customer reviews showcase, and instant call-to-action booking buttons
Fast-loading lead capture system ensuring zero inquiries are dropped

projects.title: HIT IAS Academy — UPSC & State PCS Portal
projects.architecture: WordPress CMS, Elementor Pro, Contact Form 7
projects.description: An institutional educational website built on WordPress with Elementor Pro, featuring structured UPSC/State PCS course catalogs, Contact Form 7 lead capture, and study material downloads.
projects.overview: HIT IAS Academy is a top-tier Civil Services preparation institute guiding aspirants for UPSC, UPPSC, and State PCS examinations. We designed and engineered a conversion-focused educational platform with dynamic course syllabi, faculty credentials, downloadable test papers, and instant student admission inquiry funnels.
projects.challenge: The academy needed an accessible, non-technical editorial workflow to publish daily current affairs, batch schedules, and notification popups, while delivering sub-second load times and flawless mobile usability for hundreds of daily student visits.
projects.approach: Engineered a bespoke WordPress site using Elementor Pro for modular page sections, customized Contact Form 7 with anti-spam protections and automated email alerts, and fine-tuned caching, asset delivery, and image optimization for rapid mobile rendering.
whatWasBuilt: Custom WordPress website architecture utilizing Elementor Pro for dynamic page layouts
Structured course catalog with comprehensive syllabus breakdowns and upcoming batch timelines
High-conversion student admission and demo class registration forms via Contact Form 7
Current affairs archive and downloadable PDF study material repository
Complete on-page SEO optimization and security hardening for educational portal compliance

projects.title: XChat — Real-time Messaging
projects.description: A secure, real-time mobile messaging application built natively for Android and iOS using Expo and React Native.
projects.overview: XChat is an independently developed, feature-rich mobile messaging application engineered to deliver a seamless real-time communication experience. Built with a modern React Native and Expo architecture, the application provides a smooth native feel. I designed and developed the entire application from the ground up, implementing everything from the user interface and secure Firebase authentication to the core real-time messaging engine, user presence system, and media attachments.
projects.approach: Building a real-time chat application requires precise state management and efficient database subscriptions. Using Firebase Firestore, I engineered a highly responsive message delivery system that handles typing indicators, read receipts, and online presence with minimal latency, ensuring a fluid user experience even on slower mobile networks.
whatWasBuilt: Modern real-time chat experience with typing indicators and seen status
Secure Email/Password and Google authentication via Firebase
Comprehensive user profiles with avatars, bios, and online presence tracking
Advanced messaging features including reply, react, edit, delete, and star
Rich media support for image, file, and live location sharing

about.title: Independent digital studio for the modern web.
about.description: NIVORA is an independent digital studio focused on creating modern websites and digital experiences. We combine thoughtful design with modern frontend development to create products that look good, work smoothly and adapt across devices.
paragraphs: We believe that a website should be more than a digital brochure—it should be a fast, clear, and engaging extension of your business.

By maintaining an independent studio approach, you work directly with the person designing and writing the code. There are no account managers, no inflated overheads, and no generic cookie-cutter templates.
Whether you are launching a new company, introducing a new product, or modernizing an existing web presence, we focus on what matters: clean code, thoughtful interfaces, and reliable delivery.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Honest answers to common questions about working together.

items.question: What do you need to start a project?
items.answer: A brief overview of your business or idea, your preferred timeline, any reference sites you admire, and any existing content or brand assets you have. If you don't have everything ready, we can help define the structure during discovery.

items.question: How long does a website take?
items.answer: Timelines depend on scope and complexity. A focused landing page typically takes 1 to 2 weeks, while a multi-page business website generally takes 2 to 4 weeks from initial concept to launch.

items.question: Can you work with an existing design?
items.answer: Yes. If you already have Figma designs, wireframes, or brand guidelines, we can translate them into high-quality, pixel-accurate, responsive code.

items.question: Can you integrate APIs?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate REST APIs, third-party forms, CMS platforms, analytics, and other services required by your web project.

items.question: Do you provide website maintenance?
items.answer: Yes. We offer post-launch support and ongoing maintenance to keep your website updated, secure, and running smoothly.
